items.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe, and I’m very pleased to have Steve Allen with me today.

ctx.x: Steve Allen was born in New York City on December 16, 1921. He traveled extensively with his parents who worked the vaudeville circuit, and played piano from an early age. His career has encompassed every aspect of show business, from radio and television, to movies and live performances. He is a prolific song writer, lyricist and author and currently manages Meadowlane Enterprises with his wife, Jayne Meadows. Mr. Allen still finds time for concert appearances and jazz recordings. Steve Allen was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 15, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.

We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Los Angeles. My name is Monk Rowe, and I’m very pleased to have Steve Allen with me today. I would introduce all the things you’ve done but that would probably take most of the interview.
